name: add_relationship
description: Record a relationship between two characters in the same canon, together with one evidence-backed claim. If the relationship does not exist yet it is created with this claim; if it already exists, the claim is added to it (no error) and the response shows the existing type, summary and all claim texts - check them to avoid adding near-duplicate claims. Both characters must already exist (use create_character first); if a name is not found, the response suggests close existing names. Every call needs evidence_text that is an exact quote from the page - it is checked, and nothing is stored if it is not found. Call this once per distinct claim. If no passage on the page supports a relationship, do not record it.

character_a.description: Name of the first character in the relationship

character_b.description: Name of the second character in the relationship

canon.description: Canon this relationship belongs to (e.g., 'main', 'film', 'legends'). Both characters must exist in this canon.

summary.description: Brief one-sentence summary of the relationship. Used only when the relationship is new; an existing relationship keeps its summary.

claim.description: Specific factual claim about the relationship (e.g., 'Aang and Katara married after the Hundred Year War')

evidence_url.description: URL of the crawled wiki page the quote is copied from (usually the current page)

evidence_text.description: An exact quote copied word-for-word from the page content or its infobox (e.g. 'Enemies: Azula, Ozai'), under 200 characters. Must be ONE contiguous passage: do not paraphrase, summarize, or join fragments with '...'. The quote is checked against the page text and rejected if it is not found there.
